استبرئ (form X)
# اُسْتُبْرِئَ (ustubriʔa) /us.tub.ri.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# اِسْتَبْرِئْ (istabriʔ) /is.tab.riʔ/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
